hypothesis: Known nadir intrinsics and a shared perspective ground plane constrain cameras without the affine approximation that failed in v4.
control: Exact converged homography replay from the previous cached matches; original support and audit limits unchanged.

camera_model.parameters: Two shared target-plane tilt angles and six parameters per other connected camera
camera_model.initialization: Metric column orthogonality/equal-norm upgrade and SVD rotation projection from training-edge graph homographies

gps_variant.role: weak search/fit regularization, not ground truth
gps_variant.prior_residual_units: One residual unit per prior sigma; robust loss shared with pixel residuals
gps_variant.limitations: Assumes horizontal GPS axes approximately coincide with ground-plane axes; source heading and height may be inaccurate

evaluation.masks: Identical frozen masks; all previous regions and policies retained
evaluation.new_diagnostics: Signed Sobel-gradient error and strong-edge orientation mismatch, after three-pixel accepted-mask erosion
evaluation.interpretation: Derivative diagnostics distinguish some illumination effects; they are not true geometric displacement or actual under-vehicle ground truth

limitations: Synthesized panoramas may deviate from a single pinhole camera even after nadir reprojection
No support extrapolation or threshold relaxation
Current roads are development; independent test groups remain untouched
